keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «세종대왕이 평범한 백성을 위해 한글을 만들었다(주제)» 와 «그 덕분에 훨씬 많은 사람이 글을 읽고 쓸 수 있게 되었다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (King Sejong created Hangul to help ordinary people read and write) and the conclusion (thanks to him, many more people could read and write). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why could most common people not read or write before Hangul?
qs.qko: 한글이 생기기 전에 대부분의 백성이 글을 읽고 쓰지 못한 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Chinese characters were very hard to learn
They did not want to learn at all
King Sejong did not allow them to write
evs: Chinese characters were very hard to learn, so most common people could not read or write.
It was created by King Sejong the Great to help ordinary people read and write.
Because Hangul is simple and logical, many people can learn it in a short time.
The new alphabet was first called Hunminjeongeum, which means the correct sounds for teaching the people.
why: 한자는 배우기가 아주 어려워서 대부분의 백성이 읽고 쓸 수 없었다고 했어요.
Chinese characters were very hard to learn, so most common people could not read or write.

qs.q: In «King Sejong felt sorry for them,» what does «felt sorry for» mean?
qs.qko: «King Sejong felt sorry for them» 에서 «felt sorry for» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: It was created by King Sejong the Great to help ordinary people read and write.
He finished the new letters in 1443 and shared them with the people in 1446.
Some consonants were designed to look like the shape of the mouth and tongue when making sounds.
Before Hangul, Koreans used Chinese characters to write.
why: 세종대왕은 백성이 읽고 쓰도록 «돕고» 싶어서 한글을 만들었어요. 그러니 백성의 어려움을 «안타까워했다» 는 뜻이에요.
King Sejong made Hangul to help ordinary people read and write. So «felt sorry for» means he felt sad about their problem.

qs.q: How did King Sejong help many more people read and write?
qs.qko: 세종대왕은 어떻게 훨씬 많은 사람이 글을 읽고 쓰도록 도왔나요?
opts: He made an easy writing system and shared it with the people
evs: King Sejong felt sorry for them and wanted to make an easy writing system.
Before Hangul, Koreans used Chinese characters to write.
He finished the new letters in 1443 and shared them with the people in 1446.
Some consonants were designed to look like the shape of the mouth and tongue when making sounds.
why: 세종대왕은 쉬운 글자 체계를 만들고 싶어 했고, 새 글자를 완성해 백성에게 알렸어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
King Sejong wanted to make an easy writing system, and he finished the new letters and shared them with the people. You need both sentences.

ends: How do Koreans celebrate Hangul Day?
What else did King Sejong do for his people?
세종대왕은 백성을 위해 또 무엇을 했을까?

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «중요한 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write something important and the reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because reading helps us learn)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because reading helps us learn)
write.src: “It is important to <u>learn how to read</u> because <u>reading helps us learn new things</u>.”
